message.subject: Tech analysis collaboration with EDXSO
message.email_body: Understanding how tech policy shifts impact global industries is difficult for teachers, but your video on the Huawei ban caught our attention by breaking down those massive financial costs clearly. We are with EDXSO, an education consulting team. We want to propose an exploratory sponsored walkthrough video for teachers and school leaders, with format and terms to be discussed. This gives your audience practical tools for teaching global tech competition. Please reply if a short call this month would suit you.
